_comment: How good a CURSE (negative stat) is, by stat and optionally by weapon. A curse's grade comes from here, not from its roll. Grades: S, A, B, C, D, F. Keys are Warframe Market riven stat slugs (see riven_attributes). A weapon entry beats the general stat rating. A curse stat that isn't listed falls back to the roll-based grade (and the explanation says so).

weapons._comment: Weapon name (as shown in the app) -> stat slug -> grade. Add more entries like the Felarx one.
